name: Yank Sing (Rincon Center)
why: Dim sum restaurant's Rincon Center location closed permanently after 27 years when its lease ended (WhatNow, Sept 2026). Yank Sing's own site (yanksing.com, checked 2026-10-07) also says the Rincon Center lease has ended and directs guests to 49 Stevenson St, which remains open and is in app/bay.json.

name: Tacos El Ultimo Baile (Fruitvale)
address: Fruitvale, former Nyum Bai space (street address not given in source)
why: Hoodline (June 2025) reports the taqueria left its Fruitvale location and moved to a trial stall at Saluhall, the IKEA food hall on Market St in SF; SFist (2025-05-30) says the same. Whether the Saluhall stall is still running in Oct 2026 was not checked.

name: Los Portales
why: Family-owned Mexican restaurant (opened 1993) announced its final day as Feb. 10, 2026.

name: Al Pastor Papi
why: Announced closing: Union Square taqueria will close Dec. 31, 2026 after a rent increase (still open at time of check; not added to the guide because it is closing).

name: Mama Ji's
why: Announced closing: Castro dim sum and Sichuan restaurant will serve its final meal Oct. 31, 2026 (still open at time of check; not added to the guide).
